bootstrap_method: paired unstratified family-cluster percentile, 96 family draws with replacement; same draws across all six conditions; recompute denominators
multiplicity: Holm across nine exact family-block paired-swap tests: three models by three endpoints
test_assumptions: Exchangeability of prompt labels within inferred families under the null; independence between inferred families. Observational, selected sample: not a randomized causal experiment.
interaction_scope: Descriptive paired difference-in-differences with exploratory pointwise bootstrap intervals; no confirmatory interaction tests
pilot_policy: Historical released-style scoring, descriptive paired comparisons only; no corrected-policy reinterpretation of prompt selection
supplementary_policy: Corrected policy, one accepted pair, counts only; no inferential generalization
status: New exploratory analysis of existing outputs, not preregistered; all inferential claims conditional on saved sample and heuristic families
